style: Soft painterly digital illustration in a warm storybook style: gentle brush textures, hazy atmospheric perspective, warm golden-hour light with soft violet shadows, muted earthy palette (terracotta, ochre, teak brown, sage green, dusty sky blue). Historically plausible 17th-century Ayutthaya, Siam. Calm, uncluttered, cinematic. Absolutely no people, no animals, no text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no border. Vertical 9:16 composition with an open, empty, flat ground area across the bottom third where characters will be placed later.

items.city: A wide view of the old capital Ayutthaya at dusk seen from a grassy riverbank: a broad river curving through the city, tall Khmer-style brick prangs and white-washed chedis of temples rising above wooden houses on stilts with steep tiled roofs, thin city walls along the river, many small warm oil-lamp lights beginning to glow in the houses, boats moored by the banks, a soft orange and lilac sky.
items.tower: A tall three-storey red-painted wooden drum tower with tiered Thai roofs standing over a busy-looking but empty market square at late afternoon in old Ayutthaya; on the ground floor of the tower hangs one very large barrel drum with a red body and a pale hide head, visible through the open arches; empty wooden market stalls with woven baskets and awnings around the square, a brick temple prang in the hazy background, warm low sun.
items.kitchen: The open-air kitchen area under and beside a traditional Thai wooden house on stilts by a canal in old Ayutthaya on a sunny morning: rows of split fish drying on bamboo racks in the sun, big glazed brown earthenware jars with lids, woven baskets, a clay charcoal stove, coconut palms, a small wooden boat in the canal.
items.tower3: A tall slender THREE-storey red-painted wooden drum tower (three clearly separate stacked levels, each with its own small tiered Thai roof, the top one with a pointed spire) standing at the edge of an empty market square in old Ayutthaya at late afternoon; the ground level is open on all sides with one very large red barrel drum hanging inside; the middle level has a balcony; the top level is a small lookout; empty wooden market stalls with baskets and cloth awnings around, a brick temple prang in the hazy distance.
items.tower_top: The view from the small open lookout at the very top of a tall wooden drum tower in old Ayutthaya: in the foreground the red wooden railing and floor of the lookout, beyond it a wide panorama of the city at dusk, the river, temple prangs and the city walls, and far away beyond the walls an open plain with the hazy horizon. The open floor of the lookout across the bottom third.
items.fire_night: Night view over the brick city wall of old Ayutthaya: dark blue night sky with stars, a large fire burning orange beyond the wall among thatched houses outside the city, glowing smoke rising, warm reflections on the river, the dark silhouettes of temple spires inside the wall, a few lamps. Open dark ground in the foreground bottom third.
items.drum_close: Inside the open ground floor of an old Thai wooden drum tower: one enormous red-bodied barrel drum with a pale cowhide head studded with brass nails hangs from a thick teak beam on ropes, wooden pillars, a wooden drumstick leaning on a pillar, warm afternoon light slanting in, dusty wooden floor across the bottom third.
items.market: A row of small market stalls in old Ayutthaya at morning: woven bamboo baskets of rice, dried fish, bananas, coconuts and chillies on low wooden tables under cloth and palm-leaf awnings, clay pots, a dirt lane in the front bottom third, a red wooden tower partly visible on one side, warm soft light. No people.
items.gong: A large bronze gong hanging in a carved wooden frame at the gate of an old Thai temple courtyard in bright midday sunshine, a wooden mallet beside it, white-washed walls, a golden chedi spire behind, blue sky with soft clouds, paved courtyard ground across the bottom third.
items.loubere: A 17th-century French ambassador's writing room inside a Siamese wooden pavilion: a European writing table with an open leather journal, a quill in an inkpot, a lit candle, a few rolled maps and a wide-brimmed hat on the table, carved Thai window shutters open to a view of temple spires and palm trees in late afternoon light, wooden floor across the bottom third. The journal pages show only illegible scribbles, no readable text.
items.jars: Close-up still life in a Thai country kitchen: a big brown glazed earthenware jar with its lid off showing fermented fish (pla ra) inside, next to a small bowl of dark purple shrimp paste (kapi), a basket of dried split fish, garlic, shallots, chillies and holy basil on a wooden board, warm daylight, wooden table surface across the bottom third.
